# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 or 19 years old at death  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c9 P0](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0000), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome girl with a plump, showy figure, a brilliant complexion, large bright-blue eyes, and long, thick, golden hair. In her final months she becomes very pale and thin, with hectically bright cheeks and lustrous eyes. After her death, her white-clad, delicate form is remembered in Avonlea for its consecrated, pure beauty.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Ruby is gay, cheerful, and good-tempered, frankly enjoying the pleasures of life. She is deeply preoccupied with clothes, romance, and male attention, frequently boasting about her beaux and flirtations. Though sometimes superficial and prone to sentimentality, she possesses a warm, affectionate nature and clings closely to her friends. Facing a terminal illness, she struggles against her fear of death and longs desperately for the life and love she must leave behind.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 c11 P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P17](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0017)_

## History

Ruby grows up in Avonlea and attends the local school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She later studies at Queen's Academy to become a teacher, participating in school recitations, concerts, and the Avonlea Story Club. After graduating from Queen's, she secures a teaching position at Carmody and later at White Sands. During her young adulthood, she enjoys an active social life, surrounded by numerous suitors, including Herb Spencer. However, after contracting a severe congestion in the winter, she develops galloping consumption and is forced to give up teaching. Throughout the following summer, she remains in denial about her failing health, continuing to talk gaily of her clothes and lovers. Shortly before her death, she finally admits her terminal illness and her deep fear of dying to Anne Shirley during a quiet evening in her garden. Ruby reconciles with her old friend Em White, makes peace with her fate, and passes away peacefully in her sleep at the end of the summer.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000), [v3 c14 P2](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0002), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
